identity.title: Probing UV-sensitive Pathways for CN and HCN Formation in Protoplanetary Disks with the Hubble Space Telescope

paper_type_evidence.quote: we present an analysis of new and archival *HST*, *Spitzer*, ALMA, IRAM, and SMA data for five targets in the Lupus cloud complex and 14 systems in Taurus-Auriga.
